Done. Here's what was built across 4 TDD cycles:

**`src/components/SubscriberList.tsx`** — new component owning the subscriber list markup (accessible `<ul>`, name spans, mailto links, topics).

**`src/components/SubscriberList.test.tsx`** — 4 tests covering the component's full contract:
- renders the accessible list container (degenerate)
- renders a subscriber's topics
- links a subscriber's email address
- renders each subscriber's name

**`src/components/Dashboard.tsx`** — replaced the inline `<ul>` with `<SubscriberList subscribers={subscribers} />`. Its existing 4 tests continue to pass as the integration/contract layer.
